tonight.headline: 164.8 to 85.2 with Allen still to play: the first win is all but in
body: Bad news first, and all of it is on your bench. Alvin Kamara had five touches and nobody has said why. Jordan Addison was inactive, Kyle Monangai was inactive with no new date, and Jalen Coker has not practised since his quad. None of them cost you a point today, and three of the four are candidates for a Week 6 lineup that loses Jefferson, Gordon and the Vikings' defence to byes.

The lineup was the projection lineup and it has scored 164.8: Warren 36.8, Likely 32.4, Wilson 23.4, Jefferson 18.8. ESPN gives you 99%. Nothing can be changed this week. What is left is for the moment the week rolls: McLaurin into Jefferson's slot, a body into Gordon's, and a defence, for which you hold the first waiver claim.

case.label: Their side
case.body: 85.2 so far. Purdy 7.0, RJ Harvey 0.6 and Trey McBride 2.1 were in progress at the snapshot and Drake London, 16.1, plays tonight; ESPN projects them to finish on 125.9. They left Drake Maye, 39.5, and Ja'Marr Chase, 19.7, on the bench. McBride's quarterback had thrown 11 passes by the time the archive was written, with Arizona down 24-7 at half-time.

case.label: Your side
case.body: Warren 36.8, Likely 32.4, Wilson 23.4, Jefferson 18.8, Fairbairn 16, Gordon 14.8, Tuten 11.6, the Vikings 11: 164.8, with Allen, 20.1, on Monday night. Your bench scored 12.2 from McLaurin and 2.6 from Kamara, so no points were left on it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: They need about 80 more from four players, three of whose games were already past half-time. Nothing in your hands changes it either way.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: When the week rolls · Minnesota are on bye in Week 6
doFirst.title: Swap McLaurin in for Jefferson the moment you can
doFirst.subtitle: Jefferson is on bye next week. McLaurin played, came through unhurt and was on the field in overtime. This is not a close call; it is the slot that goes empty if nobody touches it.

case.label: Why now
case.body: Every loss in the first two weeks left points on the bench, and a bye is the easiest way to do it. Minnesota are off in Week 6: ESPN's file, FOX's bye list and a local report all agree. Your other receivers are Addison, on the same bye and hurt, and Coker, who has not practised.

case.label: The player
case.body: McLaurin was a game-time decision and played, 4 catches on 4 targets for 62 with a 16-yard catch in overtime and no setback reported (NBC Sports, 21:48 UTC). Stefon Diggs was inactive again and has no timetable. Washington play at San Francisco on Monday 19 Oct, the last game of the week, so he is also your latest lock.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Minnesota are not on bye in Week 6, which three sources say they are. Or McLaurin misses practice on Thursday and Friday with the hamstring; then the slot goes to whoever Tuesday's brief names.

doFirst.sources: ESPN league file · FOX Sports bye list · NBC Sports · AP

action.label: When unlocked: start McLaurin · bench Jefferson

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · when the week rolls · Tuesday's projection picks the replacement
doFirst.title: Gordon comes out of the flex; Kamara is the placeholder
doFirst.subtitle: Miami are on bye, so the flex is empty unless you fill it. Kamara is the only bench player eligible who is not hurt on paper, and he had five touches today for a reason nobody has reported. Put him there so the slot is not zero, and let Tuesday's brief name the real answer.

case.label: Why a placeholder
case.body: Gordon will score nothing in Week 6. Of the players who can take a flex slot here, Addison is on bye and was inactive, Monangai was inactive with no date, and Coker is 'hopeful' with no practice since his quad. That leaves Kamara, and a name in the slot beats an empty one.

case.label: Why not more than that
case.body: Kamara had 3 carries and 2 catches. Kendre Miller took 10 carries and the touchdown and rookie CJ Donaldson led the backs in snaps, by an NBC headline; one NBC item suggests Kamara had no touches after half-time and its text would not open. He came into the game with a back injury. Until Wednesday's practice report, his Week 6 is unknown.

case.label: What Tuesday decides
case.body: Whether the flex is Kamara, Coker or a claim. You hold the first waiver claim in a league where the order resets every week, and Woody Marks, who took every Houston carry after David Montgomery left with a groin injury, is on waivers until Wednesday at 01:00.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Kamara is ruled out or limited all week and this placeholder is still in your flex on Sunday; or the player Tuesday's projection prefers is left on the bench and outscores him (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: Kamara had five touches and nobody has said why
whatWentWrong.lead: He was expected to play and did. Then Miller took the goal line and a rookie took the snaps.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: 3 carries for 12 and 2 catches for minus 6: 2.6 (live archive). Miller had 10 carries and the touchdown; Donaldson led the Saints' backs in snaps (NBC headline, 21:27 UTC). An NBC item filed at 21:21 UTC has an address that says he did not play in the second half and a headline that says the opposite. No recap names an injury and his coach's quoted remarks do not mention him.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The second card. He is the only healthy-on-paper flex option for Week 6, which is why he is a placeholder and not a recommendation.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A full practice on Wednesday makes it a quiet game. A missed one makes the flex Coker's or a claim's.

whatWentWrong.sources: NBC Sports · saints.com · Audacy · Week 5 live archive

whatWentWrong.title: Three byes hit your lineup next week
whatWentWrong.lead: Jefferson, Gordon and the Vikings' defence are all off in Week 6, and Addison with them.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Minnesota, Miami, Cincinnati and Detroit are on bye in Week 6 (ESPN file; FOX Sports list, 5 Oct). That takes two starters and the defence out of the lineup that scored 164.8 today.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Both cards: McLaurin for Jefferson, and a body for Gordon. The defence is a Tuesday claim, not a card today, because the best candidates are on waivers until Wednesday at 01:00 and you are first in the order.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing changes the byes. Which defence, and whose seat it takes, waits for ESPN's Week 6 projections and Wednesday's first practice reports on Monangai and Addison.

case.label: The rise
case.body: The vacancy was real: Mack Hollins is on injured reserve. But Drake Maye threw for 374 yards and spread it: six players caught three or more, Kyle Williams led in yards, and Efton Chism and tight end Eli Raridon led in catches (Boston Globe; Boston.com; PatsFans, 11 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 targets, 1 catch, 2.6 (live archive), in the best passing game New England have had. Maye missed him once in the end zone and he drew a 27-yard interference call, which is not a target. A.J. Brown 'could be back as soon as next week' (Boston Globe).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in Week 6 with Brown still out. Until then the watch is withdrawn.

doNotChase.sources: Boston Globe · Boston.com · PatsFans · Week 5 live archive

doNotChase.name: Jets D/ST
doNotChase.lead: Sixteen points and eight sacks today, and the wrong defence for next week.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Eight sacks of Deshaun Watson, three by rookie David Bailey, a strip-sack to end the game, and Cleveland held under 200 yards (AP; newyorkjets.com). They were the best free defence this morning at 8.1, and holding the Vikings instead cost you 5.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Week 6 is at New England, who scored 45 today. The 16 came against a quarterback who completed 15 of 33.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing for Week 6. They are on waivers until Wednesday in any case.

doNotChase.sources: AP · newyorkjets.com · Boston.com · ESPN league file

doNotChase.name: Roman Wilson
doNotChase.lead: The biggest riser among receivers here, and he left before half-time with a finger injury.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Michael Pittman Jr. went on injured reserve on Saturday, which is why managers added him. He played 20 snaps and drew one target.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Ruled out with a finger injury, reported on the broadcast as a dislocation (Steelers Depot, 14:45 ET). Rookie Germie Bernard took the work, 9 targets, and Pat Freiermuth scored twice.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A full practice on Wednesday. Without it the vacancy is Bernard's, and Bernard is not on this league's published wire.

doNotChase.sources: Steelers Depot · AP via Steelers Now · Week 5 live archive

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Eight targets again, and a bye next week, the week you need bodies.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 6 catches on 8 targets and a carry: 12.1 (live archive). Targets 8, 5, 10, 5, 8. No reporting on his role was found today.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Miami are off in Week 6. He cannot help the week your lineup has holes.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A second straight game of eight or more after the bye, in Week 7.

doNotChase.name: Will Shipley
doNotChase.lead: Started in London, scored, then left with a foot injury and was ruled out.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Barkley and Bigsby were out, so he started and scored from two yards.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: He left late in the second quarter with a foot injury and did not return (AP; philadelphiaeagles.com, 13:58). Dameon Pierce took over and ran 11 times for 14 yards behind a line that lost another starter.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Shipley practising on Wednesday with Barkley still out. Nobody has given a severity.

doNotChase.name: Keon Coleman
doNotChase.lead: Rising on the game DJ Moore left. He plays on Monday night and nothing has changed since Saturday.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 6 catches on 7 targets for 116 in Week 4 after Moore's shoulder took him out (archive). Joshua Palmer is out for Monday.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 1, 6, 2 and 7 (archive). Moore practised on Saturday and is questionable. 8.9 projected.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Moore inactive on Monday and eight or more targets for Coleman. Tuesday's brief reads it.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same four receivers clear the tool's bar and today answered two of them. The bar is partly an artefact: it measures them against Coker, whose last two weeks are an injury and a missed game. Four weeks of data. Nothing clears at running back or tight end. None is a move today, and Tuesday decides the rest.

rising.name: Romeo Doubs
rising.roleReason: Hollins is on injured reserve, but in today's 45-17 win the work went elsewhere: 3 targets for Doubs while six Patriots caught three or more, and A.J. Brown could return next week (Boston Globe, 11 Oct).
rising.action: WATCH — withdrawn as a candidate unless he draws eight targets with Brown still out
rising.sources: Boston Globe · Boston.com · Week 5 live archive

rising.name: Dohnte Meyers
rising.roleReason: His 9 targets came when Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins left in Week 4. Both were active today (FOX19, 12:50 ET) and he had 2 targets; his day was an 81-yard kickoff return. Cincinnati are off in Week 6.
rising.action: WATCH — the role went when both starters returned

rising.name: Stefon Diggs
rising.roleReason: Washington's second receiver, targets 6, 7, 9 (archive); inactive today with the hamstring and no timetable found on a third day of looking.
rising.action: WATCH — a Tuesday decision that needs a practice in sight; on waivers until Wednesday 01:00

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 8 targets in the game DJ Moore left (archive). Moore is questionable for Monday after a limited Saturday and Palmer is out. He has not played yet.
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore sitting on Monday night
rising.sources: therams.com · The Fantasy Footballers · Week 4 archive

settled.title: 'McLaurin into the flex if he is active' (this morning's second card, a 1.9 coin flip sent to the projection)
settled.result: He was active and you left Gordon in. Archive: Gordon 14.8, McLaurin 12.2. The card would have cost 2.6. No thesis was written on it, and it is a miss all the same.

settled.title: 'The best free defence projects 0.3 higher, which is not a move' (this morning, Vikings over Jets)
settled.result: Jets 16, Vikings 11. The hold lost by 5.

settled.title: 'Doubs: the vacancy is at least four games long' (this morning's watch)
settled.result: 3 targets and 2.6 while New England scored 45. The watch is withdrawn.

settled.title: 'Jefferson starts if active; Addison is the fallback' (the first card since Tuesday)
settled.result: Jefferson was active and scored 18.8 on 7 targets; Addison was inactive. The fallback never fired and the lineup thesis closes RIGHT.

settled.title: 'Pittsburgh raised a back, which reads as Dowdle sitting' (Saturday), priced by ESPN on Sunday morning
settled.result: Dowdle was inactive for a third straight game. Warren scored 36.8 against 17.7.

settled.title: 'Kamara is expected to play; bench him behind Gordon' (Wednesday's flex swap, carried)
settled.result: He played and had five touches: 2.6 against Gordon's 14.8. The reason is unreported, so it is graded on the score and not on the read.

settled.title: 'If Likely is ruled out: add a tight end' (the fallback carried since Wednesday)
settled.result: Never fired. Likely played and scored 32.4. Closed EXPIRED, untested.

settled.title: 'No free kicker projects above Fairbairn: hold' (this morning)
settled.result: Fairbairn 16. Chad Ryland, level on paper, scored 1; Nick Folk plays tonight.

settled.title: 'Heavy rain, an inch or so, gusts to 28 mph at Landover' (Saturday, on McLaurin and Likely)
settled.result: Three forecasts read on Sunday morning have light rain or drizzle and 8 to 12 mph. The page Saturday's figure came from could not be re-read. No move rested on it.

settled.title: 'Rain showers are likely at Green Bay' (Saturday morning, in Monangai's row)
settled.result: The National Weather Service has Green Bay sunny, 75 to 79°F. The morning figure came from a site whose labels and percentages disagreed. No move rested on it.

settled.title: 'A role that may last one more game' (Saturday morning, on Doubs)
settled.result: Hollins went on injured reserve on Saturday afternoon, out at least four games. The watch stands and the wording is corrected; Brown's return is what caps it now.

settled.title: 'If Minnesota elevate Beckham, read it as doubt and no more' (Saturday morning)
settled.result: They elevated Beckham and a second receiver, Jeshaun Jones, and downgraded nobody. Still doubt and no more; the cards did not change.

settled.title: 'New England's lead receiver again with Hollins ruled out' (Friday afternoon, on Doubs)
settled.result: The Patriots' own analysis names four receivers sharing the work and says Chism took Hollins's outside role. 'Lead' was my reading of one 9-target game. The watch stands; the wording is withdrawn.

settled.title: 'Shipley and Pierce expected to share' (Friday afternoon, from the Inquirer)
settled.result: philadelphiaeagles.com, published the same afternoon, expects Shipley 'to be the primary back'. The brief used one source when the team's own was available. No move was built on it.

settled.title: 'No danger to Sunday' for Likely (Thursday afternoon, from a team-site writer)
settled.result: Saturday morning it could not be found again and was marked down. It held: full practice, no game status.

settled.title: 'Monangai is not the drop until the thumb is known' (4–5 Oct)
settled.result: The thumb was never the problem. He is out with a toe, in a boot, seeing a specialist. The hold is leaning WRONG and closes that way if he misses Week 6 as well.

settled.title: 'Metcalf on Thursday; one more day is a small risk' (Wednesday morning's brief)
settled.result: Nicky Jam added him at 07:00, eleven minutes after the snapshot. Boston went at 06:49. Closed WRONG: the wait lost both.

settled.title: Kamara in the flex once McLaurin and Coker were out (the contingency, 2–4 Oct)
settled.result: Archive: Kamara 22.8, but Monangai, still unlocked when the swap was made, scored 28.0. Closed WRONG by 5.2, as its own falsifier said.

settled.title: 'Start Kamara in the flex; bench Coker' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: Coker was inactive and scored 0; Kamara scored 22.8 (archive). Closed RIGHT.

settled.title: If Jefferson is inactive, add Addison and start him (30 Sep)
settled.result: It fired. Archive: Addison 9.1, Kamara 22.8. The falsifier named Kamara, so it closes WRONG. Boston, the player you dropped for him, scored 12.9.

settled.title: Dropping Kyle Pitts on usage (22 Sep)
settled.result: Archive: Likely beat him 3.3 to 1.5 and 13.6 to 7.7, so the two-of-three clause can't fire. His snap share was 59% in Week 3 and I could not get a figure for Monday; PFF says 'typical 2026 levels'. Closed RIGHT on the scores.

settled.title: Tuten in the RB slot over the bench backs (the projection lineup)
settled.result: Archive: Tuten 11.1, Monangai 28.0, Gordon 18.0. No brief overrode the projection; the projection lost.

settled.title: 'Fairbairn is 0.5 better; under a point isn't a move' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: You made the swap. Archive: Fairbairn 16, Pineiro 5. The hold closed WRONG by 11.

settled.title: Claim Gordon for Achane: 'under 12 touches in Week 4 means a timeshare' (28 Sep)
settled.result: He had 11 touches, so it closed WRONG as written, and scored 18.0. The clause was badly written; the claim gained.
